question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given word.

Improbable
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Improbable"** means something that is unlikely to happen or be true. (असंभावित)

 
 
• **Example:** It is improbable that he will win the lottery twice.
 
 
 
• **"Implausible" **means not seeming reasonable or probable; failing to convince. (असंभाव्य)
 
 
• **Example:** The story he told was so implausible that no one believed him.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the most appropriate meaning of **'Improbable'** is **'Implausible'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Plausible** (संभाव्य): Seeming reasonable or probable.

 
 
• **Example:** She gave a plausible explanation for her absence.
 
 
 
• **Practical** (व्यावहारिक): Concerned with actual use or practice.
 
 
• **Example:** He has a very practical approach to solving problems.
 
 
 
• **Tenable** (तर्कसंगत): Able to be maintained or defended against attack or objection.
 
 
• **Example:** The theory is no longer tenable in the light of recent discoveries.
 
 

31:Tb5c,

The correct answer is: **Option 2**.
